lesson.concept: The same node can animate between measured layouts
lesson.why: Changing layout state lets projection compare the element's previous and next boxes. Motion-owned radius and related styles allow correction while the box changes shape.
lesson.experiment: Toggle repeatedly at different viewport widths. Watch the corners and text while comparing Rubber layout with Crisp shuffle.
lesson.pitfall: A stylesheet-only radius may distort during scaling because the engine was never told to correct it.
lesson.combine: Combine with shared layout for continuity when the representation moves to a different node.
